description: Make an Instagram Story video from a product link or one photo. Add a script, an AI avatar, and a voice, then export the tall file and post it.
h1: Make an Instagram Story Video From a Link
lead: Paste a product link or one photo. Get an Instagram Story video with a script, an AI avatar, and a voice you can edit.
steps_h2: How to Make an Instagram Story Video in 3 Simple Steps
steps_lead: You leave with a tall 9:16 Story, an avatar, and a voice.

steps.d: Add a product photo, or paste the product link. That product is the one shoppers see in the Story.
Describe the setting, pick an AI avatar, and set the voice. You can fix the spoken line before you export.
Preview the vertical Story, revise the script or voice, then download a watermark-free file ready to post.

faq.q: What is an Instagram Story video for a product?
faq.a: It is a tall video for the product, with an AI avatar and a voice. You skip filming a new clip just to fill that frame. For another motion style, start from [creator-style video ads](page:video-ads).

faq.q: How do credits work for a Story video?
faq.a: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits. Pro is $35 for 300. Premium is $63 for 600. A photo is 24 credits. A video is 24, 40, 60, or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. You see the cost first. A failed run returns the credits.

faq.q: Can I start Story videos from my product pages?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the product page. The name and the photo come through, and you still approve the script before the Story is made.

faq.q: Can I use an AI avatar in my Instagram Story video?
faq.a: Yes. Pick an AI avatar to hold the product, or build a presenter from photos you are allowed to use. You can bring that face back next time.

faq.q: How does the Story stay vertical?
faq.a: The export is a tall 9:16 file made for Instagram Stories. A Facebook Story can use the same file. Use a square only when the placement is no longer a Story.

faq.q: Can I add stickers or a price on the Story?
faq.a: Yes. Add a short line or a sticker on the video, or add Instagram stickers when you post. The price can sit in the script or go on after download.

faq.q: Can a beginner make a Story video this way?
faq.a: Yes. If you can upload one clear photo, you can finish the Story. You add the price after you download, and you do not need an editing background.

faq.q: Who should make a Story video from this template?
faq.a: A shop that posts Stories every week, and the person who writes those posts. You need the product fully in frame, not a studio booking.

faq.q: Can the Story use the photo I already shot?
faq.a: Yes. The product in the video should be the product you ship. Your logo can go on after download, and you do not need a new shoot for that.

faq.q: Can I run the Story as a paid ad or client work?
faq.a: Yes. Run it as a paid Story, leave it as an organic post, or send the video to a client who sells that product.

faq.q: Why start from a template instead of a blank edit?
faq.a: The tall frame, the avatar, and the voice are already in place. Your time goes to the offer and the words shoppers hear.
